function.name: sports_ranking_get_current
function.description: Retrieve the current ranking of a specific team in a particular league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the team whose ranking is sought.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season.description: The season for which the ranking is sought. Defaults to the current season if not provided.

function.name: get_earliest_reference
function.description: Retrieve the earliest historical reference of a person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

source.description: Source to fetch the reference. Default is 'scriptures'
